programmes.d: Mr. Bean, badgered by a strange pink animal, warms to the creature when it shows its true colours. Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms.
When invited to dinner by Mr. Bean, it’s probably best to take your own sandwiches. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven.
Mr. Bean makes it to the top of the ladder… and gets stuck. The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road.

Mr. Bean bites off more than he can chew when he attempts DIY dentistry. Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell.
It is field trip time as Sabrina’s class heads toward Monument Island where an important statue is kept.
Sabrina is just sick of the winter weather. She, Chloe, and Salem would give anything for one hour at the beach.
Sabrina has a crush on Dave, her new piano instructor.
Sabrina uses her magic to conjure up an advance copy of the latest Spy flick to make Harvey happy.

Cleo's sister Kim finds her diary and thinks that Cleo and her friends are 'evil mermaids' and she plans to tell everyone. Meanwhile, Lewis goes to Mako Island to find out more about what happened to the girls.

Rikki gains an admirer in Emma’s younger brother Elliot when she saves him from drowning. She lets him down hard causing him to run away and hide in the fernery. The girls find him just as the watering system is about to start…

The effects of the full moon turns Emma into a carefree, wild mermaid. At her father’s birthday party she’s the opposite to her usual, organised self. Can the other girls stop her before all is revealed?
A charismatic newcomer, Dr. Denman, tempts Lewis with the promise of scientific fame and fortune. Will he abandon his friends and risk their secret, all in the name of science?
Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash, but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation, she sets out to get her revenge.

Rikki enters a short film contest on the theme of 'Heroes' and decides to capture some nice underwater footage with her 'abilities'. Meanwhile, Emma is interviewing her mum and Zane and Lewis are planning to rennact Dr. Bennet's windsurfing record.
Verne is picked on by Borge and Lucrezia when they see him playing a handheld video game.
A nervous Verne flunks his compulsory Scootsoomer driving test because he's afraid of heights. But he manages to conquer his fear at the Centre of the Earth on a wild ride.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.

Charlotte follows Lewis to Max Hamilton. Max tells all to Charlotte when he discovers she’s the granddaughter of his one true love. Charlotte and Lewis almost break up until she goes to the moonpool, becoming a mermaid herself!

The girls have to deal with a fourth mermaid who turns out to be a loose cannon; Charlotte almost turns into a mermaid at a volleyball competition. Charlotte discovers she has all three mermaid superpowers.

As the girls continue to have problems accommodating Charlotte as a mermaid, Nate bullies Lewis. Despite the girls’ attempts to keep Charlotte under control, she uses her powers on Nate and almost exposes them all.

Charlotte takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis, annoying Rikki. At the party, Charlotte is jealous of Cleo and traps her and Emma in a pool room. Rikki comes back just in time. From now on, Charlotte is on her own.

Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.
During Errie's annual Tornado day, Matt Frewer drops in as a wacky meteorologist whom Marshall helps battle Tornado Bob.
Marshall and Simon are startled by a creepy kid who's living in an old mill that's haunted by the ghost of Eerie's worst bank robber ever.
Seventeen year old Nathan is a star athlete who would do anything to play pro basketball.
Convinced that his Aunt Melva is too old and helpless to live on her own, a young city boy named Dale drives out to the "sticks" to retrieve her.
When surfer dudes Ben and Mike mistakenly travel to Austria instead of Australia, they find themselves aboard the midnight run of the Translyvania Express railway.
When Buddy and Vince skip school one too many times to play their favourite video arcade game "Monster Attack", they find themselves magically transformed into a real life version of the game.
A vacation in Australia starts on the wrong foot when Rip's wallet is stolen, and left at the sight of a stolen Tjuringa Stone, a sacred aboriginal artifact believed to control peoples dreams.
When convicted fraud artist, Howard Hawkins is released on parole, he swears revenge on the men who put him in prison Rip and Cyril!

A trip to New Orleans to purchase The Evil Eye, a rare voodoo artifact, results in the Voodoo Museum's curator being turned into a zombie by a High Priestess who attempts to prevent the sale from going through.
When Sam is to be a bridesmaid in a friend's wedding, the BION team travel to Kampala, Uganda.
Sh'lainn's death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours...
Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti...
Kenta battles Reji for Yu and confuses him by switching Sagittario and Yu's bey Libra's performance tips.
After a fierce battle with Ryuga, Tsubasa is eliminated from Battle Bladers; Ryuga issues a challenge to Gingka who readily accepts.
Battle Bladers Semi-Finals pits Gingka against Reiji; Doji takes Yu away, so Hyoma and Kenta go to the Dark Nebula to save him.

Gingka manages to defeat Reiji, using a mirror to reflect his attacks back; Phoenix helps rescue Yu and defeats Doji in battle.
De La Porta holds Tann's parents hostage in Paris, forcing him to lead Lua into a trap.
Jason, Kong, Tann and Lua travel to Los Angeles to stop De La Porta from stealing a stone tablet that contains the secrets of the Primal Stones.
Robotnik's insane cousin, Dr. Warpnik, captures Tails and lures Sonic into his Zone of Confusion in order to enact revenge on Robotnik for banishing him.
When Reggie falls in love with a B-movie queen, he buys a magical potion to bring her out of the film and into Riverdale.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Beware of the Glob!
programmes.d: When Miss Beazely mistakenly uses water from one of Dilton's experiments for her school lunch pudding mix, the school dessert comes to life.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Day the Earth Moved
programmes.d: Giant, toothy-mawed worms the size of freight trains are plowing beneath the grounds of an old section of Riverdale, eating cars, buildings and anything they can detect moving on the surface.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Dance of the Killer Bees
programmes.d: Humanoid bee creatures begin causing trouble for the people of Riverdale after their leader, the Queen Bee, decides to make the attic of Riverdale High her new hive.

'No Pink is an Island': Captain Pink and the Aardvark are stranded on a desert island and captured by a horde of ants. 'Pinky and the Golden Fleece': Shepherd Pinky goes on a quest to retrieve Goldie, the king of Greece's stolen royal sheep.

'Home Stretch Pinky': Horse trainer Pinky tries to help Granny win the Kentucky Fedora - the world's famous horse race. 'Pink Pucks': To win a big hockey game, Pink conjures up Slusho to play goalie, only to have him lured away by an ice seductress.

'The Reluctant Ninja': To retrieve the stolen jade monkey for the Empress of China, the Panther enlists the help of martial arts master Ho Hum. 'Pantherella': The Panther reads the classic tale of Cinderella, but everything in the story's wrong!

'Pink's Ark': Pinky vies with Manly Man for the last space on Noah's ark. 'Rain or Snow or Pink of Night': Mailman Pinky must prevent the insidious Dr. Jellyfingers from mailing a sticky bomb to the stadium to end football season once and for all.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.

Grandma's long-time foe, Zazu, places a curse on the family, which turns anyone the Howards touch into a werewolf. Zazu agrees to lift the curse if Scott can give her an old photograph of her and his grandparents.
